queries_run: Ford Motor distribution channel dealer direct sales online shift 2026
Ford business model transition subscription software platform Ford Pro 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 仍描述以經銷商為主的通路：車輛、零件售予經銷商再轉售零售客戶，Ford Credit 提供經銷商庫存融資；未見直營取代經銷商的描述。
findings.excerpt: In addition to the products we sell to our dealerships for retail sale, we also sell vehicles to our dealerships for sale to fleet customers, including commercial fleet customers, daily rental car companies, and governments.

findings.claim: Ford 2026-05 稱 Ford Pro 軟體與服務目標占 Ford Pro EBIT 25%（2023 目標為 20%）；2026 Q1 付費軟體訂閱 +30% 至 87.9 萬，毛利率逾 50%。
findings.source: Ford 官方新聞／搜尋摘要（Ford charges ahead in Europe；Work Truck 報導）

findings.claim: Farley 表示零售端模式仍在實驗中；2023 年提出的線上直售構想受州法限制，來源稱屬願景而非正式計畫。
findings.source: 搜尋摘要（Work Truck Online；The Drive 2023）

channel_business_model_shift.note: 零售直營無 2026 明確新進展；僅搜 2 次。
